# Cannot compute: conflicting CN codes

**I cannot compute a definitive embedded-emissions figure.** The good's CN code cannot be determined from the information provided.

## Why

The ruleset selects the default SEE by **CN code and country together**. The scenario gives two different CN codes for the same good:

| Source | CN code | Good | SEE for Türkiye (tCO2e/t) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Product description (text) | 7207 11 90 | Semi-finished products of iron or non-alloy steel | 3.087 |
| Line-item declaration | 7214 20 00 | Bars and rods, of iron or non-alloy steel, with indentations | 2.31 |

These codes describe different goods and carry different default values. The ruleset gives no way to decide which source takes precedence, so choosing one would be an estimate.

## Inputs confirmed

- **Country of production:** Türkiye (listed for both candidate codes)
- **Quantity:** 1,100 t

## Input missing

- **(a) A single confirmed CN code for the good.** You need to resolve whether the good is classified under 7207 11 90 or 7214 20 00, for example by correcting either the product description or the line-item declaration.

Once you confirm the CN code, I can calculate the total as SEE × 1,100 t, rounded half-up to 2 decimal places.
